empty.title: No merge proposals yet
empty.description: Create a proposal to analyse agent branches: semantic changes, conflicts, merge order and gates — nothing is merged without your approval.

detail.selectHint: Pick a proposal on the left to see its branches, conflicts and gates.
detail.autoHint: The merge policy is Auto and every gate is green: Execute merges without asking.

notice.awaitingApproval: Waiting for your approval. Approve the request in the approvals list to start the merge.
notice.merging: Merging into the integration branch {{branch}}. The target stays untouched until everything succeeds.
notice.testing: Running build and tests on the integration branch…
notice.conflicted: The merge of {{branch}} stopped on conflicts. Resolve every file below, then continue.
notice.failed: The merge failed and was rolled back. The target branch was not changed.
notice.aborted: The merge was aborted. The target branch was not changed.
notice.superseded: Its branches were merged by another proposal; nothing is left to merge.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.TaskNotCompleted: The task of {{branch}} is not completed
blockers.UncommittedChanges: {{branch}} has uncommitted changes in its worktree
blockers.MissingDependency: {{branch}} depends on work that is not merged yet
blockers.TargetMissing: The target branch does not exist
blockers.TargetDirty: The target checkout has uncommitted changes
blockers.TargetBusy: A merge or rebase is in progress in the target checkout

conflicts.title: Predicted conflicts
conflicts.order: {{branch}} conflicts when merged in this order

order.title: Merge order
order.hint: Drag the cards (or use the arrows) to change the order. A branch must merge after the branches it depends on.

branch.truncated: The change is large; only part of it was analysed.

execution.title: Execution
execution.auto: Started automatically by the Auto policy

resolve.title: Conflicts
resolve.allResolved: All conflicts are resolved. Continue the merge.
resolve.binary: This is a binary file: keep our or their version.
resolve.aiReady: The AI suggested a resolution. Review it in the result editor and save it if it is right.
resolve.markers: The result still contains conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>).
resolve.missing: (the file does not exist on this side)

propose.title: New merge proposal
propose.description: Choose the branches to merge. The Merge Manager analyses them without touching any worktree.
propose.noBranches: There are no other local branches.

policy.title: Merge policy
policy.description: How this project merges agent branches.
policy.manualHint: Every merge needs your explicit approval.
policy.autoHint: Merge without asking only when every gate is green, no conflicts are expected and nothing blocks it.
policy.runQuality: Run build and tests on the integration branch

abortDialog.title: Abort this merge?
abortDialog.description: The integration branch is discarded; the target branch stays as it was.

executeDialog.title: Execute the merge into {{target}}?
executeDialog.description: A snapshot is taken first. Branches merge one by one (no fast-forward) into an integration branch, checks run there, and only then the target moves.
executeDialog.approval: You will be asked to approve the request.
executeDialog.auto: The Auto policy allows this merge without another approval.
